question: Ishan is younger than Surya by 3 years. If the ages of Ishan and Surya are in the ratio 7:8, then how old is Ishan?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of ages of **Ishan** and **Surya** = 7 : 8

Difference in ratio parts = 8 − 7 = 1 unit

Given **age difference** = 3 years ⇒ 1 unit = 3 years

**Ishan age** = 7 units = 7 × 3 = 21 years

**∴ The correct answer is 21 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f0ea74103d54247669415bd161ac4c4164b9c10727b8609da475f3578da913d.png] 

**Given:**

Ratio of **Ishan age** to **Surya age** = 7 : 8

Let the ages be 7x and 8x.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Age of Surya − Age of Ishan = 3

⇒ 8x − 7x = 3

⇒ x = 3

⇒ Ishan age = 7x = 7 × 3

⇒ Ishan age = 21 years

**∴ The correct answer is 21 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio and Proportion

If two quantities are in ratio a:b, they can be represented as ax and bx, where x is the common multiplier.

Age Difference Constant

The numerical difference between the ages of two persons always remains constant regardless of the number of years passed or preceding.

Unitary Method in Ratios

Difference in ratio units corresponds to the actual numerical difference. 1 unit = (Actual Difference) ÷ (Difference in Ratio parts).</p
